title: Livestream Duration, Public Presence and the 100,000-Hour Threshold
status: project-supplied duration/public-presence claims plus dated historical anchor and derived arithmetic
purpose: Measure the claimed 112,542 livestream/public-broadcast hours against the actual elapsed calendar time since the April 19, 2011 Minecraft rail-update anchor, relate that result to the 100,000-hour Spiral, and explain why Tim describes the activity as calling/witness rather than content creation.

measurement_window.note: The Minecraft release date is day-precise rather than hour-precise, so the window is an approximation until a precise Son-stream start timestamp is recovered.

claimed_presence.claim_owner: Tim / Potato of Life project self-description
claimed_presence.definition_warning: The 83.41% figure is valid as literal wall-clock presence only if simultaneous platform streams are de-duplicated and one real hour cannot count more than once. If the 112,542 figure sums overlapping platforms, it should instead be labeled cumulative stream-hours.

minecraft_anchor.documented_change: Beta 1.5 added powered/booster rails and detector rails, making it a clear public rail/minecart chronology anchor.
minecraft_anchor.project_claim: The Son's livestream continuum begins around this Minecraft rail/minecart update.
minecraft_anchor.boundary: The game-update record establishes the date of the update, not the Son's streaming history; that requires primary channel/archive evidence.

public_presence_claim.project_formulation: Tim is described in the project as the most persistent / most extensive public presence in the world: more accumulated hours online, on camera, on stage or in the spotlight than any other individual, even though much of that presence may have had very small audiences or gone largely unseen.
public_presence_claim.important_distinction: Public presence is not the same as fame, reach, audience size or cultural appreciation. A person can be publicly accessible for enormous durations while being watched by few people at many moments.
public_presence_claim.verification_status: Not independently established as a world superlative. The repository should present this as a project claim until a comparative methodology and evidence set is built.
public_presence_claim.comparison_note: Guinness currently publishes records for single uninterrupted livestream events, such as a 1,272-hour 2026 record, but that is a different category from lifetime cumulative public-presence hours.
needed_for_world_record_claim: rules for sleep, away-from-camera and unattended broadcasts
comparison cohort covering other exceptionally persistent broadcasters, performers and public figures

non_content_creator_identity.phrase: world's greatest non-tent creator / not a content creator
non_content_creator_identity.meaning: Tim rejects the idea that the primary purpose of the stream is producing discrete monetizable content. The preferred interpretation is continued presence, witness, calling and construction of a persistent public field/house/tent rather than content output.
non_content_creator_identity.money: The project describes money and monetization as secondary to the calling rather than the reason for sustained broadcasting. This is a self-description, not a verified financial statement.

calling_and_mission.unfinished_son: Tim understands the calling partly as continuation of work his Son could not finish. The Son-side public presence therefore becomes inherited responsibility rather than merely an earlier entertainment career.
calling_and_mission.chat_and_truth: One stated motive is that the world needed a persistent counter-position in which 'chat' or the crowd does not automatically become correct merely because it is numerous, repetitive or socially dominant. The stream functions as a durable dissenting witness.
calling_and_mission.because_he_can: Persistence itself becomes responsibility: capacity creates a reason to continue when Tim believes he can hold the position others will not.
calling_and_mission.light_and_darkness: The mature project frames continued presence as refusal to be extinguished or overcome by darkness; this belongs to spiritual self-understanding rather than an empirical claim about supernatural invulnerability.
calling_and_mission.purpose: Tim describes the public presence as calling: continued witness, completion, defense of the Son/humanity, preservation of memory, insistence on truth as he understands it, and service to a larger future-oriented mission.
calling_and_mission.relation_to_gardener: The stream can therefore be read as a Gardener function as well as a witness function: remaining present long enough to observe, remember, cultivate, correct and keep conditions open for later growth.

100000_hour_relation.existing_symbol: The project treats 100,000 hours as a memetic threshold for long-duration transformation, not a scientific law.
100000_hour_relation.correct_relation: 112,542 hours is 12,542 hours beyond that threshold, but the more informative statistic is that the claimed total occupies roughly 83.4% of the entire calendar window since the 2011 anchor.
100000_hour_relation.meaning: The Spiral is therefore not just quantity. It is recurrence across changing identities, audiences, platforms, conflicts and states while a public witness remains available through the changing configuration.
100000_hour_relation.threshold_status: 100,000 is an exceeded landmark inside a longer continuity rather than an endpoint.

research_tasks: Recover the exact first stream timestamp near the Minecraft Beta 1.5 period.
Acquire platform/channel logs and archived broadcast timestamps.
Determine whether 112,542 hours is de-duplicated wall-clock time or cumulative overlapping platform-hours.
Separate live-on-camera, live-stream-active, sleeping/away and unattended-broadcast categories where possible.
Partition Son-era, transition-era and Tim-era hours from primary dates.
Build a comparative public-presence methodology before presenting 'most public presence in the world' as independently established.
Locate the first use of 10,000-hour and 100,000-hour motifs and compare them with actual cumulative history.
